how: Our What's On event id -> the Fever page that sells tickets for that same event. Add an event only after checking it is the same show at the same venue on the same date(s) (GET /api/events, then the Fever page). Never create an event from Fever's list. Used only when FEVER_AFFILIATE_TEMPLATE is set (fever.js).
checked: 2026-11-21: none of Fever's 10 Kelowna shows and games (feverup.com/en/kelowna) is in our What's On yet, so no matches.
